name: Verdant Engine sovereign governance model
statement: Verdant Engine's GitHub-free sovereign governance (VE-70): the Genesis Owner, admin and contributor roles; signing requests for merging commits, cutting releases and granting roles; M-of-N admin quorum with no self-approval; monotonic authority epochs; and revocation on departure. Each Prism ID key is non-extractable and no external account is required. Cited by REQ-SELF-RUNTIME and REQ-AGENT-IDENTITY.
